findings.problem: Approved save/list/mark-read journey has no implementation or executable protection.
findings.principle: Preserve title and address while changing read status; keep read articles in the queue.
findings.consequence: Product success and JSON persistence cannot be demonstrated.
findings.fix: When implementation is selected, add one public journey check using a real temporary JSON file: save known title/address, list, mark read, list again, reopen the app or queue from disk and list. Assert read status, unchanged title/address and continued membership. Use node:test and node --test; wire into one repo-owned check command. Exceptions: mocked storage may supplement this check but cannot replace it for readiness.
findings.verification: Execute via the real presentation boundary and JSON adapter when available. Seed a title/address mutation, dropped read article and non-persisted status separately; each must fail. No private helper or JSON-layout assertions.

findings.problem: Storage ownership is approved but has no executable code or review enforcement yet.
findings.principle: Presentation uses public queue operations and never writes storage directly.
findings.consequence: A future presentation write could bypass queue invariants and corrupt article state.
findings.fix: Review presentation imports and write paths against DESIGN.md:5 for each affected change. Queue owns save/list/mark-read and persistence access. Keep this as a human review rule initially; only select semantic import analysis if the future native toolchain can express it. Exceptions require a reviewed design change, not a silent bypass.
findings.verification: Review a permitted public queue call and reject a representative direct presentation storage write; if automation is selected later, prove valid and seeded-invalid imports with native tools.

findings.problem: No project source states what evidence completes a change or where acceptance checks live.
findings.principle: Proposed: completion requires affected approved journeys to pass on final inputs.
findings.consequence: Passing future isolated unit tests could be mistaken for evidence of the reader journey.
findings.fix: Add one short verification section to DESIGN.md when selected. Link VISION.md:5 and glossary.md:4-5 to the maintained journey check and repo-owned check command. Record command, runtime version and result on final inputs; missing or failing journey evidence leaves readiness unverified. Keep formatting/lint values in selected native configs; choose applicable type checks only when language setup exists. Human scope review rejects accounts/sharing/recommendations for version one. Exceptions must name a bounded reason and removal condition and retain an unverified outcome.
findings.verification: Review the section against approved source bytes; confirm the named check exists, passes the full real-storage journey and returns nonzero on seeded outcome violations. Documentation alone cannot satisfy readiness.
